newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.African economists see growth slowing in '97.
newsitem.headline: S.African economists see growth slowing in '97.

text.p: A survey of 27 South African economists has shown they expect growth in gross domestic product (GDP) to slow to between two and 2.2 percent next year, the Business Times reported on Sunday.
The paper said the survey, conducted by Professional Management Review magazine, indicated that the private sector economists expected last month's rate rise to slow consumer spending.
"The survey paints an optimistic picture for 1998, with most economists expecting stronger growth than in 1997," Business Times said.
"The majority of the economists believe the government will implement its macro-economic strategy successfully in 1997," the paper said.
